title: Sakura Cranes
desc: Sakura Cranes is an Asian themed destination based off the Takedera Temple founded in Ancient Japan in 857. Upon arrival, you will walk down the stone steps through the cloud forest into the bamboo gardens. There are several areas of respite, including a beautiful tea house, serene gardens, a floating restaurant, a small temple, and fully furnished rentals available for peaceful getaways.

title: Hiraeth Beach
desc: Hiraeth Beach is a secluded coastal escape where sea, wind, nature and forgotten history meet. Wander along wild shores, explore ancient ruins and a mysterious temple, discover hidden places beneath the sea, or simply find a quiet spot overlooking the horizon. Hiraeth is a Welsh word for a longing for a place that feels like home, even if you have never known it. More than a beach, Hiraeth is a place to explore, photograph, or simply slow down and breathe. Some places are visited. Others are remembered.

title: Korea City Seoul
desc: Seoul, the dynamic capital of South Korea, invites you to discover a unique blend of modernity and tradition. Enjoy weekly performances by various K-pop artists, live singers, and DJs! Join in, dance to your heart's content, and receive various gifts for free. Take a romantic stroll with your partner, enjoy a date, and create special memories with couples dances. There are many photo-worthy spots to capture beautiful moments. Experience a variety of activities and events welcome, and have fun!

title: OBSIDIA
desc: OBSIDIA is a remote and enigmatic place, suspended between the present and the unknown, somewhere between tranquility and unease, where reality seems to dissolve. It may feel like an escape from everything, yet there is always a lingering sense that something more awaits, something yet to be discovered.

title: CLAW
desc: CLAW is an immersive PBR-enabled environment for socializing, gaming, and capturing memorable photos.

title: Luanes World - Le Monde Perdu - Autumn
desc: Step into a peaceful autumn landscape inspired by the beauty of Gudenåen in Denmark. Rez a boat, bike, or horse and set off along the winding trails, surrounded by golden trees, quiet waters and the colours of the season. Follow the paths, discover little corners along the way, or find a quiet spot by the water to camp. Bring a thermos, slow down, and simply take it all in. No rush. No destination. Just autumn, nature and a little time to breathe. Come explore. Come wander. Come stay awhile.

title: Storybook
desc: Welcome to Storybook, a fairytale forest dedicated to your childhood bedtime stories. Find your favorite fairytales, take pictures and explore!

title: Omerta Island
desc: Omerta Island, crafted by designer Lux Voxel, is an evolving paradise where romance and adventure intertwine. With a hotel to explore, this destination offers unique, paid experiences that captivate every visitor. Exclusive membership unlocks custom experiences, special access, and exclusive giveaways. AI-driven characters, brought to life by professional actors and much more.

title: Isle of Rowlyria
desc: Isle of Rowlyria is a Mediterranean Isle where you can hang out, rent homes, relax by the sea and mountains, go virtual fishing, take beautiful pictures, and listen to some of the best DJs.

title: Old Town at Adagio Gardens
desc: It is an Old Town: a place of tree-lined cobblestone streets, brownstones, and small shops. Built in a time of elegance, Old Town is beautiful in its bright autumn colors. Browse the shops, wander through the farmer's market, play in the carnival, or find a cozy spot to relax and take in the season. When the music starts, join in at the Old Town stage for live karaoke and community gatherings. Come explore and enjoy autumn in Old Town at Adagio Gardens.

title: Pususaari
desc: Welcome to Pususaari, a quiet romantic island dressed in autumn colours. Wander through a charming old fishing village, explore the farm and its horses, meet curious bears, and discover a beautiful wild wolf pack hidden among the woods. The little chapel has returned to Pususaari, this time with a secret of its own, while Pusuhenge is waiting with another touch of magic. Follow winding paths through golden forests, along the beach and rocky shores, stop by the café, find hidden corners, peaceful places, and small stories scattered across the island. A place for lovers, dreamers, explorers, and photographers, filled with nature, animals, autumn scenery, and many more surprises waiting to be found.

title: The Looking Glass at Horizon Dream
desc: The Looking Glass is the joint creation of Marcus Inkpen and Sharni Azalee. Beautiful art and designs populate this photogenic island, which aims to host and support the arts in Second Life through live music, particle shows, and poetry readings.

title: Adagio Gardens - Undersea to Winterland
desc: Nestled between sun-kissed beaches and rolling skies, Adagio Gardens invites you to wander through a world of wonder. Dance beneath the stars in the elegant outdoor ballroom, then explore themed venues that span eras — from the depths of Undersea Cove to nostalgic Old Town, rugged Old West, and sparkling Winterland. Every corner offers a new scene, a fresh experience, and a chance to linger in beauty, music, and imagination.

title: TETRA
desc: A coastal destination with a beautiful forest filled with birds, trees and wind sounds. An amazing wild beach with rolling waves and sea sounds makes you feel at peace there. Home to the TETRA store which offers a great choice of high-quality women's clothing and footwear, fitted for a variety of female mesh bodies.

title: Chouchou
desc: Since 2008, Japanese music group Chouchou has brought their creativity to Second Life in several photogenic and atmospheric regions, including "Memento Mori," "Islamey" and "The Babel."

title: Buddha Garden
desc: Welcome to Buddha Garden, a paradise of pleasure, relaxation, and meditation. You can spend moments of serenity surrounded by nature. Discover the "Ancient Dragon Theater" underwater.

title: Yamato
desc: Yamato, a quiet costal town, is a residential and social destination inspired by rural Japan during the 2000s.

title: Grand Harbor Isle
desc: Experience fall at Grand Harbor Isle! Explore beautiful rentals, stroll through cozy autumn décor, and enjoy the colors and charm of the season. When night falls, gather your courage and venture down the spooky haunted trail. Come visit Grand Harbor and celebrate the magic, mystery, and excitement of fall!

title: The Burrow
desc: The Burrow rises above a wild countryside with crooked charm, inviting visitors to step into a world inspired by childhood stories of magic and friendship. Nestled among tall trees and winding paths, it feels like a place where beloved characters might still gather.

title: Amandia Beach & Opium Club
desc: Welcome to Amandia, the flavour and the colors of an Italian beach village, and Opium Club. It's a place for photos, relaxation, and hanging out. Visit and enjoy the Italian-style architecture.

title: Kaleidoscope - Monarch Education Project
desc: Kaleidoscope, a Monarch Education Project, brought to you by MORPH Productions and SPARK Project, is an experience for the mind, heart, and soul. Follow the nature hike to learn about the importance of this beautiful butterfly and experience the breathtaking views of the monarch wintering grounds. Immerse in the butterfly experience while cuddling your beloved.

title: Cherishville Autumn
desc: Welcome to the Autumn 2026 edition of Cherishville, a peaceful, photogenic destination where you can relax, socialize, and take pictures. Free rezz is available for photography enthusiasts.

title: The District
desc: The city is calling. The District brings NYC energy to Second Life with streets made to wander, hidden corners to uncover, creator storefronts to discover, rooftops, restaurants, subway stops, and endless photo opportunities. Every block tells a different story in a city built for exploration, creativity, connection, and the community that brings it to life.

title: Pour Up Winery & Vineyard
desc: Established in 2021, Pour Up Winery & Vineyard is a scenic, romantic destination perfect for dates, with wine tasting, paint and sip, pottery, fishing, ziplining, horseback riding, live music events,  and vineyard views. Visitors can relax, explore, and enjoy photo opportunities throughout the grounds.

title: Lenixus Project - Chapter II
desc: Lenixus Project is a personal artistic experience, for both the creator and visitors. A story told through exploration; environments, details, and atmosphere, without always explaining everything. It evolves over time, sometimes unpredictably.

title: Ocho Tango Place
desc: Ocho Tango Place is the home of Argentine Tango. Dance beneath the lights of Buenos Aires while listening to Radio Ocho Tango's carefully curated selection of traditional orchestras, valses, milongas, and contemporary tango. Experienced tangueros and those taking their first steps will find a welcoming atmosphere filled with social dancing, romantic settings, photogenic corners, and a shared love of tango. Here, music, movement, and connection come together in a space where every dance tells a story.

title: Sant' Agapito
desc: A former Roman settlement, Sant' Agapito, was extensively redeveloped in the Middle Ages. Separated from the later nineteenth-century "upper town," it now offers a refuge of boutique shops, cafes, and quiet corners. Below the town is a fragment of ancient woodland with a lakeside terrace overlooking more period ruins. Lots of photo opportunities.

title: Soul Deep - Hope & Oceans
desc: Where the salt wind carries whispers of Autumn. Wander weathered beaches, follow winding paths through golden grasses, and rest beneath trees that lean toward the sea. Here, hammocks sway, campfires glow, and gulls wheel above an ocean that feels endless. This is a place for slow breaths, long looks, and soul-deep moments, where hope drifts in like the tide and stays a while.

title: Seraphara Sultanate
desc: Immerse yourself in the culture and extravagance of an Arabic-style destination at Seraphara Sultanate. Live in an authentic Arabian tent, walk the Souks, smell the spices, and have a famous Turkish coffee at the Seraphara Cafe. Enjoy the lavish Harem and Hammam with dancers in jewels and silks swirling and music filling the soul.

title: Infinite Darkness
desc: Good and evil, water and fire, light and dark, are the essence of Infinite Darkness. The majesty of the gothic style, the occult symbolism, and the dark powers of the vampires will immerse you on a hellish journey.

title: A Touch of Italy
desc: A beautiful island to explore and lose yourself. With its central shopping district, northern and southern beaches, a winery and wedding venue, a forest and plenty of hiking trails. Hop (or swim) over to the small northern sea island and explore the scuba spots!

title: Mall Paradise
desc: Mall Paradise takes you back to the 80s once more, and this time bigger and better. The neon lights are bright, the mullets are right, and the fun lasts throughout the night. Live your life the 85' way.

title: Batterie Beach
desc: Discover Batterie Beach, a gritty boardwalk and amusement park infused with New Orleans spirit. This beachfront locale offers an edgy and urban escape. Stroll along the boardwalk, snap unforgettable photos, or simply absorb the vibrancy of this unique open space.

title: Sanctuary
desc: Established in 2008, Sanctuary has long been celebrated for its award-winning historical roleplay, and now has evolved into a vibrant cultural space for art, photography, dance, music, and theater—welcoming global gatherings and creativity without borders. It's also a beautiful region for taking photos.

title: Ethereal City
desc: Established in 2008, Ethereal City is an urban-themed, photogenic destination. Autumn settles over Ethereal City with crimson canopies, leaf-strewn stone plazas, lamplit balustrades, a quiet vendor's cart, and a cozy horse-drawn carriage through quiet streets. Wander slowly; it's a memory you can step into.

title: Black Kite
desc: Black Kite has been placed with care by Black Cloud. It is blogger, photographer, and explorer friendly with an auto-return set to 60 minutes. Share your pictures in their Flickr group: flickr.com/groups/black-kite

title: The Wastelands
desc: The Wastelands is a post-apocalyptic community almost as old as Second Life itself. Despite their frightening outward appearances, their friendly and outgoing community is the core reason they've lasted so long. Whether you want to role-play, hang out and chat, or play the mini-mmo games they have; everything is free, and opt-in at your own pace. It is also a photo-friendly destination! Learn more at the-wastelands.org

title: Lutz City of Templemore
desc: Beyond the iron wrought gates and stone sculptures that usher you past the brick archway lies Lutz City of Templemore. Templemore continues the celebration of Live Music in SL through Lutz City with its amazing ambient and nested stages.

title: Le Chateau - A Retro 80s Community
desc: Do you like vacations and hanging out while drinking an exotic cocktail by the poolside? Then Le Chateau is the place for you to be! With their kitsch and cheesy atmosphere and non-stop flowing exotic cocktails, a mix between French and American "80s'" culture atmosphere, they offer a wide variety of services, from the jungle-like airfield to the arcade room! Take your pick!

title: Sahira Public Gardens
desc: Sahira Public Gardens is a welcoming place to relax, spend time with friends, and take photos. Explore the gardens to find a camping area, beach, lake, old house, and spots with animations to enjoy together.

title: Velvet Vale
desc: Velvet Vale is an exploratory destination with romantic, natural settings. All themed areas are open to the public and feature atmospheric lighting, seasonal changes, weekly live music, dancing, role-play areas, an outdoor cinema, and a few residential rentals - so please respect each other. Visitors are invited to explore, bring a friend, and unwind.

title: LeLoo's World - Dancing Leaves
desc: LeLoo's World – Dancing Leaves is a place where the season wraps around you, inviting you to wander, breathe deeply, and feel the calm magic of Fall. Enjoy a peaceful stroll along the lakeside, complete with its charming balloon tour, or wander into the adjoining woodland paths. Throughout the area, you’ll discover cozy spots perfect for capturing those special autumn photos. Everyone is welcome to this PG event!

title: The Village at Winchester Estate
desc: The Village at Winchester Estate is a richly detailed coastal community created for wandering, exploring and simply enjoying the atmosphere. Follow the waterfront past the old church, harbour buildings and wooden piers. Discover quiet corners and small surprises, or just sit by the water and watch the world go by. Designed with a strong sense of place and plenty of detail, The Village rewards visitors who take their time and look around.

title: Kickers Creek Fall Festival
desc: Step into Kickers Creek, a charming little community where there is small-town warmth that has been transformed into fall! The community comes alive with fall colors, pumpkin picking and carving, a scavenger hunt, and plenty more! Whether you're stopping by for a visit, looking for a place to call home, or simply looking for something fun to do, there is always something happening around Kickers.

title: Ofrenda Nocturna
desc: Ofrenda is a rugged, natural spot with much interest for photographers and dreamers. Relax, immerse yourself, and indulge your senses. Find those surprises and don't get lost. This is an adult destination, with something for everyone, so be ready to explore!

title: La Vie en Rose
desc: La Vie en Rose is a romantic spot filled with flowers, majestic trees, and peaceful nooks. Come for a stroll, breathe in the fresh air, and share a magical moment, alone or as a couple. Let yourself be captivated by the beauty of the place.

title: Rainy Alley
desc: Rainy Alley is an old alley lost in time. It's a small space that aims to bring you peace and relaxation in your busy life.

title: Qaldera
desc: An idyllic retreat designed to be explored with emphasis on nature - featuring a beach, forests, waterfalls, barn, resort, and lake. It is roleplay-friendly and restricted to adults only. Humans are encouraged but everyone is welcome.

title: Le Chateau Countryside
desc: Le Chateau Countryside is a picturesque and residential destination experience that encapsulates the essence of the idyllic French countryside. From charming thatched cottages to picturesque hamlets, and even an authentic village complete with a quaint church, the region has been crafted with the utmost care and attention to detail. Throughout the year, it will transform with 4-seasonal changes, providing an ever-changing and immersive experience.

title: Vice Islands
desc: Explore the new Vice Islands region, part of Le Chateau estate, inspired by Scarface and Miami with a funky neons retro decor, roads to ride your 80s muscle car, a beach, a mall, and pools! The perfect spot for your Miami-inspired photo.

title: Pillars Of Hercules
desc: For over five years Scottie Menges and Caleb Bruun ran the first Pillars Of Hercules open from 2009-2014. Now after ten months of building, Pillar of Hercules returns in 2022 as a public park open to anyone looking for a romantic and neoclassical fantasy destination where you can learn about Greek and Roman mythology.

title: Nana Land
desc: Nana Land is a scenic nature retreat for photography, romantic dancing, exploring, shopping, and quiet moments with friends or someone special. Visitors can wander landscaped paths, relax among the gardens, and discover plenty of photogenic spots throughout the region.

title: Village de Roqueblanche
desc: Roqueblanche is a little village nested in the southern of France. Visitors can explore the countryside, sunlit homes, a charming café, and an art gallery. It is an Albane Claray creation.

title: Big Sky Over Florence
desc: Enjoy the sea at Big Sky Over Florence. Listen to the calming ocean sounds and relax on the white sand beaches. Hang with friends on any of the public spaces or try your hand at some photography. There are plenty of pretty views. Simply enjoy the peace and tranquility of this lovely spot and unwind. Everyone is welcome! Owned by White Dunes Estate. Check the greeter for information about rentals and please be considerate of the tenants. Add your images to their Flickr group: flickr.com/groups/florenceatlowtide

title: Ipperwash Cliffs National Seashore
desc: Ipperwash Cliffs National Sea Shore is a public park dedicated to the enjoyment and beautification of mainland SL. There are miles of roads and trails ideal for hiking and horseback riding and beautiful vistas for photography. Nearly two full regions of shores, cliffs, forests, and meadows to explore.

title: Tonarino
desc: Explore Tonarino, a Japanese urban neighborhood town, that blends traditional and modern elements. It's very photogenic and fun to explore. Don't forget to share your images in their Flickr group: flickr.com/groups/14689051@N23

title: Timeless Memories
desc: Timeless Memories is a lovely Mediterranean Island. Be amongst the sun-bathed cliffs of this secluded island and immerse yourself in this subtropical experience. A gorgeous cliff-top house and two beautiful beach homes each with panoramic views of the sky and emerald waters. Set your worries free in this idyllic paradise. Owned by White Dunes Estate, check the greeter info about their rentals and please be mindful of the tenants.

title: The Outer Garden
desc: The Outer Garden is a place where love is hiding. The landing point is filled with happiness where the romantic atmosphere and pale lights surround you, which would make your time with friends and lovers special. Click the mirror at the landing point to teleport to other gardens, where you can enjoy walking and taking pictures. Go on an adventure at this magical fantasy destination.

title: Cravone City
desc: Inspired by New York, Cravone City is an urban region that is great for photography, roleplaying, and hanging out. Come explore the shops, cafes, and parks. With numerous streets and alleys, Cravone provides plenty of ways to get lost and find yourself again.

title: Bayou du Chat Noir
desc: A bayou setting in Southern Louisana full of character, as well as characters, and a down-home feeling. Great for photography.

title: Chinese Duke's Mansion
desc: A highly faithful reconstruction of an ancient princely mansion complex. In ancient China, a princely mansion (wangfu) was a top-tier aristocratic architectural complex second only to the imperial palace. Its interior furnishings and garden environment were indeed highly refined, integrating the essence of ritual hierarchy, feng shui, garden art, and arts and crafts.

title: October
desc: October at alphatribe island is a sprawling village where houses are people! This is quite a crowded little place with lots of inhabitants, busy fetching water from two wells, admiring fountains, hanging around, gossiping, and generally enjoying the lovely Autumn afternoon. A granddad is telling some tall tales to his granddaughters - but they are sort of hidden, so you will have to look for them. A young man is having a sad episode by the sea - thankfully, he has a cat for company! A bunch of mutinous scarecrows is having a confab in a field. A flotilla of toy ships is chugging by. And the villagers are conscious of keeping the place neat and tidy - so you will encounter some very respectable folk wielding brooms against the onslaught of fallen leaves.

title: Atlantis Corp
desc: Join Atlantis Corp's expedition to help restore the lost city to its former glory. Explore the home of Moss Hollow and JK/NX, visit the Leatherwood Club, browse the Aether & Brine Bazaar, and discover exhibits at the Hespira Art Gallery.

title: Venesia
desc: Discover Venesia, inspired by the timeless beauty of Venice! Step into a city where romance, elegance, and adventure meet. Glide along picturesque canals on a gondola tour, wander through charming streets, and capture unforgettable moments at countless scenic photo spots. Set sail to the Blake Sea, arrive by air at Venesia Airport, and experience everything this vibrant city has to offer.

title: Kaleidoscape
desc: Escape to Kaleidoscape, a peaceful medieval countryside filled with flower fields, working farms, hidden gardens, rustic taverns, and scenic walking trails. Whether you're looking for photography, quiet exploration, or simply a place to relax, every corner offers a new story waiting to be discovered.

title: DayDream Believer
desc: DayDream Believer is a place to relax, have fun, and enjoy scenic photography spots or a quiet date. Set between sleeping and waking, this dreamlike destination invites visitors to wander through its mysterious surroundings, where not everything is as it seems.

title: Mayonaka City
desc: Welcome to Mayonaka City! Catch a DJ set at one of the 4 music venues scattered across the city, take a stroll through the gardens, get lost in the neon district, or enjoy a bite to eat at one of the many waterfront restaurants!

title: The Gardens of Silversides
desc: A place where souls wander and where the softness of the night invites you to stroll along the paths. An original creation of Albane Claray sponsored by Blackwater Property Rental.

title: memories of dreams resurrected
desc: Far to the north, where the sea stretched cold and dark beneath a low autumn sky, a small fishing village clung to the rocky edge of an island. Weathered wooden houses stood close together against the wind, their walls silvered by years of salt and rain. Nets hung from rough poles to dry, and small fishing boats rocked in the harbor, their hulls creaking softly with the tide.

title: Southern Roots
desc: In the south we say grace, listen to mama, sweeten the tea, know the neighbors, bless hearts, use manners, love like crazy, catch lightnin' bugs, live simple, say hey y'all, count our blessings, wave at strangers, give warm hugs, and marry for love. Add your images to their Flickr group: www.flickr.com/groups/southern_roots

title: Bridgewater
desc: Bridgewater offers a peaceful country landscape with sea views, rustic charm, and photo-perfect spots. Explore its historic water mill, church, cottage café, and cricket oval under wide skies. Designed for relaxed walks, storytelling, and photography, it’s a destination where details invite calm exploration.

title: Awenia Faerie
desc: Awenia is a Faery Tourist Trap. Bring the kids! Awenia boasts a crystal grove, a book forest, a sacred grove, beautiful photo opportunities, and many remembrances of Fantasy Faires past and recent. You'll find one-of-a-kind items such as The Last Hope statue, The Shrine Tree, and the Well of Whispers. Stay for a little while....stay forever.

title: Lost Swamp
desc: Lost Swamp is a quiet and atmospheric destination where misty waters and whispering trees create a backdrop for reflection and photography. Visitors can explore its calm paths and find inspiration in its timeless setting.

title: Chaos and Calm
desc: Chaos & Calm offers an urban rooftop hangout above and a peaceful countryside setting below. Built by Megan Premier, this destination is popular for photography, casual gatherings, and growing live music events.

title: Loktak Lake
desc: Loktak Lake is a large, freshwater lake located in the Northeast of India. It is known for its unique floating islands, called phumdis, which are made up of soil, vegetation, and organic matter. Stay around for a while, you'll be immersed into weather phenomena you've never seen or heard in Second Life before!

title: Zodiac Sands
desc: Zodiac Sands is a serene Mediterranean escape where visitors can unwind beside a turquoise sea under a deep blue sky. Feel the soft ocean breeze and relax in this coastal paradise. Owned by White Dunes Estate, this destination invites respectful exploration. Check the greeter for rental info and enjoy the tranquil atmosphere while being mindful of tenants.

title: Kingsand
desc: Kingsand is a photographer's delight! A gorgeous scenic island with an assortment of secret and cosy areas to enjoy some privacy with friends, family, and loved ones or to relax and enjoy some alone time.   With elements of the mystical, with a sprinkle of whimsical - bring your camera and be enraptured by Kingsand's charm and beauty!

title: Sunset Sands Retreat
desc: Escape to Sunset Sands Retreat, a modern Mediterranean oasis perfect for a summer getaway. Situated within a Sailing Simulation linked to the Blake Sea, where visitors can truly immerse themselves in the beauty of water and ocean. Dine at the beachside restaurant, Have fun and relax in private cabins with spa treatments by the waterfall. Your slice of heaven awaits.

title: Mirai Melody
desc: Mirai Melody is the look at the future (未来 – Mirai) with respect to the past (過去 Kako). Where two friends filled with mutual passion for old-meets-new. A place where the vibrant colours of the city are wrapped in the soft warm melody of nature.

title: Love Kats Community
desc:
Come by and visit Love Kat's Residential Community! It's a great spot to hang out with friends and if you are so inclined make it your home. Love Kat's expanded to offer some great homes to call your own.
The Love Kats community consists of two new residential regions and a third public region that also houses the Love Kat's Live Music Venue. You can enjoy live music 5 days a week!

title: Piazza Dell'Artista
desc: Piazza Dell'Artista is an old Tuscan Village that has become a home for local artists. It has a scenic, natural, and romantic environment with beautiful gardens. It's a place to wander, dance, and take amazing photos.

title: Azure Haven
desc: Step back in time at Azure Haven, a serene 19th-century Mediterranean island. Wander through olive groves and lavender fields, or relax by the stone fountain. Discover the rustic fishing hut by the sea, and don't miss the dolphins playing in the waves. Add your images to the Flickr group: flic.kr/g/3fZsYL

title: Autumn Trace
desc: Welcome to the wildlife rich wetlands of the Autumn Trace that come alive as the sun breaks through the mists of the morning. Immerse yourself in this romantic and heartfelt destination. Owned by White Dunes Estate, check the greeter info about their rentals and please be mindful of the tenants.

title: Photo Cafe
desc: Photo Cafe' is a meeting place for all SL Photographers (at any level) to gather and share experiences, hints, tips, and tricks, landmarks or contests (inworld or on socials), and whatever else comes to mind! They hold moderated discussions, events, and exclusive or retrospective exhibits. Learn more at www.photocafe.news

title: The Relic
desc: The Relic is a place to relax, socialize, and connect in a beautiful natural setting provided by the University of New Mexico. Join discussions and talks about interesting topics with the aim of cultivating a community of practice.

title: Islands of New England
desc: New England Islands is inspired and modeled on the real-life US Cape Cod Islands. Visit and reclaim your childhood memories of seashells, reed-covered tiny coiling marsh channels, and endless ocean waterways for relaxing, great sailing while passing by lovely handcrafted dunes, beach shores, and cranberry bogs to savor the scenic beauty. Please visit and consider making this community your home.

title: Ethereal City Legacy
desc: Please enjoy all the fabulous things to do with this Autumn Refresh - train rides, coffee spots, dining, new cuddle spots, and general breathtaking scenery as well as new locations of Sake To Me, and a new Top of Legacy hangout spot. So much to do and see!

title: Wolf Land
desc: Wolf Land is a wild territory and the realm of wolves. It's an immersive landscape where deep nature meets the silent, majestic presence of wolves. Designed as a wild sanctuary, the region leads visitors through dense forests, misty clearings, and peaceful lakeshores where the outline of a wandering pack can sometimes be seen. The region was rebuilt to mark the 25th anniversary of the French non-profit organization loup.org

title: Bellefleurs & the Village of Binnancumb
desc: Spectacular Bellefleurs has been the seat of the Duchesses of Demnonica and Omnium for centuries. The current, detailed great house offers an incredible treasure of artwork, and a rare, complete medieval church sits nearby in the Village of Binnancumb. Bellefleurs offers an active, classical Salon Music series, gardens, dances, En Garde fencing, as well as other daily events. All are welcome.

title: The Hamptons
desc: The Hamptons is a beautiful, relaxing retreat for everyone to enjoy. Gorgeous photogenic scenes of nature can be experienced and explored, which were inspired by Northern East Coast and Western European landscapes. This lovely destination has plenty of hideaways to cuddle, relax, and get away from from the crowd and the noise.

title: The Endless Graveyard
desc: The Endless Graveyard is a forest in Sweden that exists at the edge of the land of the living. Can you find the hidden doorway to the realm of the dead? Add your images to their Flickr group: flickr.com/groups/legioamorte

title: Summer Trace
desc: Come breathe the sea air and take a bracing walk along cliff tops and sandy beaches. Lay amongst the flowery meadows and let your mind be free at Summer Trace. Owned by White Dunes Estate, check the greeter info about their rentals and please be mindful of the tenants.

title: Olde Lapara Towne
desc: Olde Lapara Towne features an abandoned railroad bridge running through its historic downtown, now transformed into an elevated walkway with trees and picnic spots. Visitors can enjoy views of the streets, watch the SLRR mainline, ride the town's trams, and explore the surrounding shops and historic streets.

title: Skye Neist Point
desc: Skye Neist Point is a landscape for dreamers and photographers to hang out and take in breathtaking scenery - a massive cliff tower topped by the Basilisk Castle, lush ravines, forests, and dune-scapes. Follow cliff and forest paths or dally on one of the interactive scenes. It is also home to the Studio Skye store.

title: Runestone
desc: Runestone is a magical Pacific Northwest retreat where breathtaking natural beauty meets fantasy. Wander through a scenic winery, explore a hidden mermaid grotto shimmering beneath the waves, and uncover the secrets of a pirate cave filled with adventure and legend. Whether you're seeking a peaceful escape, a romantic destination, or a place to let your imagination roam, Runestone offers enchanting settings for weddings, traditional handfastings, celebrations, photography, and exploration.

title: Rosa Scotia
desc: Arrive on the picturesque docks of Rosa Scotia, a whimsical journey back in time. During a period where the moment stood still, and the laughter and joy of the people was bountiful. Enjoy the lush downtown historic district offering a truly remarkable sense of mom and pop and community based business, purely decoration. As well as a vineyard, and relaxing beach to enjoy the smell of the air.

title: Rieri - Town in Tokyo
desc: Visit Rieri-Town, an incredibly realistic town modeled from Google Maps and real photos of Tokyo neighborhoods. Come and visit to feel the atmosphere of this contemporary Japanese location.

title: Poughkeepsie
desc: An amazingly whimsical photography region with plenty to see and do. From date night, chilling by the fire, relaxing in the library, or taking on a game in the arcade (yes the games really work!)

title: Northern Shore
desc: Inspired by the Swedish Skärgården this bustling fishing port captures the essence of those idyllic islands. Grab yourself a coffee and freshly baked pastries from the cafe and watch the local fishermen bring in the fresh catch of the day. You can explore this rocky landscape on foot or by the sea on our new rubber dinghies, or own your cottage and immerse yourself in the role of becoming a true archipelago resident. Owned by White Dunes Estate, check the greeter info about their rentals and please be mindful of the tenants.

title: Mount Campion Caves National Forest
desc: Mount Campion Caves National Forest is over 150,000 sq meters of beautiful parkland, landscaped to look like a natural mountain park. It has the largest natural caves and caverns. Above ground are miles of scenic trails through natural canyons and forests. There is hiking, horseback riding, camping, and photography. and cabin rentals.  Located on the slopes of Mount Campion, the highest mountain in SL on the beautiful Heterocera mainland continent. You can roam for weeks!
